_what: Role-to-person assignment map for existing jobs and stage packets. Holders are person IDs in team/people. Roles select assignees; they do not add a queue or an execution-permission gate.

creative-strategist.job: Runs video-teardown and video-writing: the swipe torn down, then the brief written

video-producer.job: Runs video-production from an accepted brief: voice, stills, clips, then the edit kit
video-producer.note: The video editor also holds the production role; the owner remains a holder (2026-11-17).

video-editor.job: Runs video-edit on the edit kit: the finished cut, filed for approval

graphic-designer.job: Makes the pictures for an image brief

project-manager.job: Coordinates assigned promo, storefront and funnel work through the existing task queue and workflows

email.job: Runs email writing, final copy review, popup preparation and the authorized scheduling workflow in their own account
email.note: Owner ruling 2026-10-18: the project manager owns Write it, final wording and scheduling; design stays with the graphic-designer role.
